JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

WITH user_gmv AS (

    c.customer_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_gmv

  JOIN

  GROUP BY

  FROM user_gmv
),

  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    total_gmv,

  FROM ranked_users
  WHERE percentile <= 0.2

  (top_20_gmv / all_gmv) * 100 AS top_20_percent_contribution
FROM 
  top_20_percent_users, total_all_gmv
LIMIT 1;

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的 GMV 中，新客和老客各贡献多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 获取2018年的订单数据
orders_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id, 
        customer_id, 
        order_purchase_timestamp,
        -- 计算订单金额（假设order_items中每个订单只有一条记录，否则需要SUM）
        (SELECT price FROM order_items WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.order_id LIMIT 1) AS order_amount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' 
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
),
-- 获取每个客户的最早订单日期（用于判断新老客户）
first_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- 标记2018年订单中的新老客户（2018年首次购买的为新客户）
customer_type AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN fo.first_order_date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' 
                 AND fo.first_order_date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 'new'
            ELSE 'old'
        END AS customer_segment
    FROM orders_2018 o
    JOIN first_orders fo ON o.customer_id = fo.customer_id
)
-- 按月份和新老客户统计GMV
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv
FROM customer_type
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp), customer_segment
ORDER BY month, customer_segment
LIMIT 24;
